name: second-brain
description: One Git-native project knowledge folder for Claude, Codex, and optional Obsidian, with fixed properties, project tags, visible provenance, read-only health reports, owner-approved saves, read-only Claude Code session search, and safe migration.

interface.shortDescription: One Markdown project brain for agents and people.
interface.longDescription: Installs one knowledge folder containing the project overview, generated index, specifications, seven persistent memory types, project-specific tags, visible provenance, read-only health reports, raw brainstorms, and minimal optional Obsidian settings. Claude and Codex share the same Markdown and Git truth. Saves use short owner-approved meaning reviews, startup loads only the map, local Claude Code session search stays read-only and historical, and migration detects flat, retired, mixed, unknown, and new layouts without guessing.
defaultPrompt: Set up project knowledge in this project
Detect and plan this project's knowledge migration
Review this completed work for persistent updates
Find a past Claude Code discussion that current project files do not answer
